note: E1; E3-E4: FY2025 total water consumption fell from 281 ML to 250 ML (about 11%), meeting the qualitative aim to improve overall water consumption in FY2025.
E6; E8-E9: the FY2024 report restates the target of at least 15 community/social events and reports over 80 CSR activities, surpassing it.

E5-E7: in 2025 ThaiBev only 'has started to install' the biocarbon plant at United Winery Distillery; no completion is reported, and no evidence after 2025 is shown to settle whether the installation was finished.
E5; E8: the FY2024 report says Scope 3 was completed, fully deriving all material categories (seven disclosed) this year; E12 confirms.
E2-E3; E9: the target for all KUDs to be ISPO certified was moved to 2026, and the 2025 report still has only four certified KUD with one part way through the audit.

E3; E7: a qualitative climate scenario analysis was incorporated (2024) and reported as conducted in the 2025 report; a deliverable finished before the deadline counts. E5/E12 plan a further quantitative analysis, which the promise did not specify.
E7: the 2023 report says the aim to complete substitution testing by end-2023 was delayed; E10 (2024) still trialling a new formulation.

E4; E10-E11: the evidence attaches 'carbon emission intensity' from a 2020 baseline, which the extraction omits. E4's 'not achieved on time' sits in a combined energy/emission row with no clear column attribution, while E10 reports a 32% absolute Scope 1+2 cut, a different measure; the verdict for this target cannot be told.

E8-E9: the waste target (50% reduction in sludge and rubber lump waste intensity from 2020 by 2025; extraction omits the intensity qualifier but it is the same single waste target, cf. E2) was explicitly not met and delayed.
E5; E7; E9: FY2022 average training hours per employee reached 13.0, surpassing the 10-hour target.
